# Intelligent Membranes

> > Passivhaus-certified liquid-applied airtight and waterproofing membrane systems for high-performance building envelopes.

Intelligent Membranes specializes in innovative liquid membrane solutions including Passive Purple for airtightness, Surface Pro for surface protection, and fire-rated systems for timber frame, light gauge steel, and retrofit construction. Products are certified by KIWA and designed to meet Passivhaus, EnerPHit, and Net Zero building standards.

## Key Topics

- Passive Purple
- Passivhaus
- Liquid-applied membranes
- Airtightness
- Building envelope
- Retrofit airtightness
- Waterproofing membranes
- Timber frame construction
- Light Gauge Steel (LGSF)
- Surface Pro
- EnerPHit
- Fire-rated systems (FRED)
- Vapour control
- Energy efficiency
- Sustainable building

## Core Products

- [Intelligent Membranes Store](https://intelligentmembranes.com): Passivhaus certified liquid airtight & waterproof membranes for buildings
- [Passive Purple](https://intelligentmembranes.com/pages/passive-purple): Passive Purple airtight membrane for LGSF, timber frame & OSB substrates
- [Passive Purple External: The Liquid Armour for Timber Frame](https://intelligentmembranes.com/pages/passive-purple-external): Passive Purple External: breathable weather barrier for timber frames
- [Passive Purple & Fred](https://intelligentmembranes.com/pages/passive-purple-fred): Passive Purple & FRED fire retardant system for Passivhaus & high-rise
- [Passive Purple X (10kg) - Spray/Roller](https://intelligentmembranes.com/products/passive-purple-x-10kg-white-spray-roller): Passive Purple X 10kg: fire-rated, breathable external coating for spray
- [Passive Purple External Brush Pack](https://intelligentmembranes.com/products/brush-applied-facade-waterproofing-membrane-5kg-bundle): Passive Purple External brush pack: facade waterproofing membrane 5kg
- [Surface Pro Brush 4kg - Brush Applied Hard Surface Protection Film](https://intelligentmembranes.com/products/hard-surface-protection-film): Surface Pro Brush: liquid latex hard surface protection film, 4kg
